items.title: Economic optimism plunges to lowest level since Great Recession
items.zh_title: 经济乐观情绪跌至大衰退以来最低水平
items.zh_oneliner: 盖洛普调查显示，美国消费者经济乐观情绪跌至大衰退以来最低，通胀担忧仍是主因。
items.en_oneliner: Gallup finds U.S. consumer economic optimism at its lowest since the Great Recession, with inflation still the main worry.

items.title: ACI Worldwide’s CEO heads out
items.zh_title: ACI Worldwide 首席执行官离任
items.zh_oneliner: 支付公司 ACI Worldwide 首席执行官离任，管理层出现变动。
items.en_oneliner: ACI Worldwide’s chief executive is departing, marking a leadership change at the payments company.
